about.intro: Vanilla Smiles is a dental and esthetic practice in Andheri West, Mumbai — general, cosmetic and children’s dentistry under one roof, at a pace that leaves room for questions.

announcements.text: Mon – Sat · 10:00 – 21:00 · Andheri West, Mumbai · Walk-ins subject to slots

products.name: Consultation & Check-up
products.description: A full examination of teeth, gums and bite, with a written plan and costs if anything needs treatment. The starting point for every new patient — and the right appointment if it has simply been too long.
products.fabric: Visual examination · gum assessment · digital X-ray only if clinically needed
products.care: Bring a list of medicines you take and any previous X-rays. Nothing else is required.

products.name: Scaling & Polishing
products.description: Ultrasonic removal of plaque and tartar above and below the gum line, then a polish to lift surface staining. The single most useful appointment for gum health, and the one most people postpone.
products.fabric: Ultrasonic scaling · hand instrumentation where needed · polishing · gum advice
products.care: Avoid very hot or cold food for a few hours. Mild sensitivity for a day or two is normal.

products.name: Tooth-Coloured Filling
products.description: Composite restoration for a cavity or a chipped edge, matched to the shade of the tooth so it disappears in daylight. Done under local anaesthetic, usually in one sitting.
products.fabric: Local anaesthetic · decay removal · layered composite · bite check and polish
products.care: Avoid chewing on that side until the numbness has fully gone — usually two to three hours.

products.name: Root Canal Treatment
products.description: For a tooth that is infected or badly broken down. The nerve space is cleaned, shaped and sealed, then the tooth is restored — often the alternative to an extraction.
products.fabric: Diagnosis and X-ray · rotary cleaning and shaping · sealed with a restoration
products.care: Expect mild tenderness for a few days. A crown may be advised afterwards to protect the tooth.

products.name: Teeth Whitening
products.description: Professional whitening for stained or dulled enamel, using a custom-fitted tray so the gel reaches the tooth evenly and the gums stay protected. Shade change varies by person and by starting colour.
products.fabric: Shade assessment · custom tray · supervised gel application · follow-up shade check
products.care: Avoid tea, coffee, red wine, turmeric and smoking for 48 hours after each session.

products.name: Veneers & Smile Design
products.description: A planned change to the shape, shade and proportion of the front teeth — starting with a mock-up you can see before anything is permanent. Suited to chips, gaps and discolouration that whitening cannot fix.
products.fabric: Photographs and shade mapping · digital or wax mock-up · trial smile · bonding
products.care: Avoid biting nails or opening packets with the front teeth. A night guard is advised if you clench.
products.colour: 2–3 visits · plan depends on the number of teeth

products.name: Clear Aligners
products.description: Removable, nearly invisible trays that move teeth in planned stages. Suited to crowding, spacing and mild bite correction — assessed first with scans or impressions to confirm what is realistic.
products.fabric: Scans and treatment plan · aligner stages · scheduled reviews · retainers at the end
products.care: Wear 20–22 hours a day. Remove for eating and drinking anything other than water; rinse the trays.

products.name: Ceramic Braces
products.description: Fixed braces with tooth-coloured brackets for more complex movement than aligners can manage. Wires are adjusted at each review so the movement stays on plan.
products.fabric: Bonding appointment · ceramic brackets · wire adjustments · retention planning
products.care: Avoid hard and sticky foods. Use the interdental brushes we give you — they are not optional.

products.name: Child's First Visit
products.description: A short, friendly introduction to the chair: counting teeth, showing the mirror, and a gentle examination. No treatment is forced — the goal of visit one is that visit two is easy.
products.fabric: Tell–show–do introduction · examination · fluoride varnish if appropriate · parent briefing
products.care: Bring them fed and not overtired. A favourite toy is welcome.

products.name: Sealants & Fluoride
products.description: Preventive care for young molars: a thin coating over the grooves where decay starts, plus a fluoride varnish. Quick, painless, and far cheaper than treating what it prevents.
products.fabric: Cleaning · sealant application · fluoride varnish · home-care demonstration
products.care: No hard chewing for 24 hours on the treated teeth. Normal brushing resumes the same evening.
